summary: Qualify mail in the actual hosted runtime. Workers cannot open TCP to a Cloudflare-protected Hostinger SMTP address; explicit authenticated HTTPS reuses the canonical gateway and SMTP protocol with a durable idempotency ledger, fixed recipients and preserved Reply-To. No ambiguous delivery is retried or sent through another provider.
rollback: Revert only this opt-in renderer transport and owned deployment. Keep existing transport defaults, D1 enquiries, relay ledger and old WordPress/DNS rollback evidence. Never retry an unknown message.
